rawRetro.summary: Continued the restored partial implementation of Issue #303. Kept the server-only design: two default Notification channels (test-inbox and test-inbox-failure) delivered by a minimal application-registered 'test-webhook' provider into an in-process loopback receiver mounted at /api/test-notifications/receiver[/failure]. The normal channel ends 'accepted'; the failure channel returns HTTP 400 with a fixed reason so the diagnostics page shows a failed delivery with the preserved reason. Added the missing end-to-end test that starts a real standalone server on a chosen port, signs in as the seeded admin, lists test targets, sends to both channels, and asserts the recorded delivery status and failure reason. No schema or data was added, so no migration or seed was needed.

blockers.title: Cookie-authenticated POST to an application route is rejected with 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN when the app is started directly, not through pnpm dev
blockers.symptom: The new end-to-end test signed in successfully and could GET /api/notifications/test/targets, but POST /api/notifications/test/send always answered 403 {"code":"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN"} before reaching the route handler.
blockers.rootCause: Better Auth protects cookie-authenticated unsafe methods by checking the request Origin against its trustedOrigins. The application config leaves app.publicOrigin unset, so better-auth's baseURL is unset and its static trustedOrigins list is empty. pnpm dev compensates by injecting APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN and BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS into the server child, but a test or script that starts the runtime itself gets no trusted origin, so every cookie-authenticated write is rejected.
blockers.resolution: The end-to-end test now starts the runtime with APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN set to the loopback origin it listens on and sends a matching Origin header, mirroring what pnpm dev does for the browser. The product code was already correct; only the direct-call test setup was missing this environment.

improvements.title: Standalone test harness does not set a public origin, so cookie-authenticated writes fail outside pnpm dev
improvements.detail: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts's createInstalledStandaloneServer/createIsolatedStandaloneServer helpers do not set APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN. Existing tests only read (GET /api/users), so this stayed hidden. Any new test that POSTs to a non-auth application route with a session cookie hits INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN and needs to know about pnpm dev's private environment contract.
improvements.suggestedChange: Have the standalone test helpers default APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN (and BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS when a listener port is known) to the loopback origin the test reaches, or document the requirement in the testing reference. That keeps direct-call integration tests from rediscovering the CSRF origin rule.

evaluation.summary: 本轮需求是用 Notification 与已有 Provider 机制做一个最小"发送测试通知"入口：单渠道、向隔离测试接收端发送、在现有诊断页看到最终投递状态，并提供可控失败且保留原因。NocoBase3 的基础能力基本对得上：app-plugin-notification 提供 Channel→Provider 注册表、Provider 运行时契约、结果分类、测试 API、状态存储与诊断页；app-plugin-notification-providers 提供可复用的 im 消息处理器（测试表单、PreparedImMessage、校验），使应用只需写薄 HTTP 传输层。Agent 按指引用 notificationExtensionRegistryToken 在 boot() 注册自定义 provider、复用 messageType 'im'、用 defineApiRoutes 挂一个进程内回环接收端，诊断记录显示 accepted（接收端 200）与 failed（接收端 400，lastError 保留），QA B01/B02 均 passed。发现的框架范围内问题很有限：通知级汇总状态 completed 的措辞可能与"已送达"混淆；另外独立启动测试时缺少可信 origin 导致 cookie 认证写请求被 CSRF 拒绝，这是模板/测试环境背景问题，不是通知能力缺陷。

modules.name: Notification 渠道/Provider 扩展与投递结果契约

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-notification/SKILL.md
entrypoints: 读取顺序与扩展章节路由
自定义 transport 通过 notificationExtensionRegistryToken 注册

modules.scope: 把一种自定义外部通知渠道接入 Notification 运行时，并让失败原因进入持久化记录所依赖的注册表、Provider 契约与结果分类。
modules.limitations: 只覆盖 Provider 侧扩展路径，未评估内置 SMTP/Resend/Feishu/DingTalk provider 的实现质量；未覆盖 in-app 渠道。

requirements.need: 提供一个可实际投递的外部通知渠道，并保留每次投递的失败原因，同时不另写投递框架。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 Channel→Provider 注册表、Provider 运行时契约（send/validateConfig/生命周期）与投递结果语义；应用只负责本场景的传输实现与受控失败接收端。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 从容器解析 notificationExtensionRegistryToken，用 registerProvider 注册一个全局唯一的 NotificationProviderDefinition，声明 messageType 复用消息处理器，并在 send() 返回 accepted/failed/submission_unknown。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 boot() 中解析 notificationExtensionRegistryToken 并 registerProvider；provider 用 messageType 'im' 复用现成消息校验，未自建投递框架。

requirements.need: 受控失败必须在诊断记录里保留真实原因，且未配置/失败渠道不能被标成成功。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责持久化 Provider 返回的错误分类/消息并据此汇总状态；应用负责决定何时判为失败。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 失败时返回 { status:'failed', error:{code,category,message}, disposition }，结果不确定时返回 submission_unknown；不要返回 accepted。
requirements.actualUsage: 应用 provider 在 4xx 时返回 failed 并转发接收端 message，5xx/超时返回 submission_unknown；QA 记录显示 lastError 被保留、失败渠道为 failed。

requirementFit.reason: registry.js 提供唯一扩展点并校验 provider id 与 messageType，types.d.ts 的 ProviderSendResult 与 channel-manager.js 的结果处理直接满足"接入一种渠道并保留失败原因"，应用只需写薄传输层。

usability.reason: 解析 token→registerProvider→返回结果联合类型步骤少，messageType 复用现成消息处理器；唯一隐含前提是注册须在插件 register() 之后、start() 之前完成（故用 boot()）。

agentFriendliness.reason: SKILL.md 与 channel-and-provider-extensions.md 明确给出 token、定义字段、结果分类与错误类别，Agent 实现与指引一致。

design.reason: 定义（definition）与运行时（provider）分离、按 messageType 复用消息处理器、provider id 全局唯一，公开抽象边界清晰。

reliability.reason: 阅读实现：channel-manager.js 对 accepted/failed/submission_unknown 分别落库，失败时按 disposition 决定 retrying 还是终态 failed，错误随 attempt 与 delivery 持久化。

modules.limitations: 未逐行审阅客户端日志页全部实现；未评估实时订阅与通知中心其它页面。

requirements.need: 提供一个最小"发送测试通知"入口，并能按渠道在现有诊断页查看最终投递状态。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 test targets/send/status API、鉴权与日志页；应用只需配置渠道与接收端。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 通过插件自带的测试 API/对话框，一次只选择一个已配置 Channel；每个测试都生成持久日志且仅创建者可见。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 未另建页面，直接用插件的 Settings>Notifications>Notification logs 与测试对话框；QA B01/B02 实际提交并记录通过。

requirements.need: 区分"已受理"与"已送达"，失败不得显示为成功。
requirements.responsibility: 框架在 delivery/attempt 层区分 accepted/failed/unknown 并保留 lastError；应用需用独立接收端提供最终送达证据。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 读取 delivery 状态与 lastError，把 accepted 仅理解为 Provider 受理，并用外部接收端日志佐证。
requirements.actualUsage: QA 记录中 accepted 对应接收端 200、failed 对应接收端 400 且 lastError 被保留，未把失败标成成功。

requirementFit.reason: routes/index.js 的测试面、store.js 的状态汇总与插件自带日志页直接支撑"每渠道一次测试发送并查看状态"，本次 QA 两个条件均 passed。

usability.reason: 测试目标只暴露安全字段描述符，对话框与日志页由插件提供，应用无需写 UI；小缺口是通知级汇总状态 completed 在语义上可能与"已送达"混淆。

agentFriendliness.reason: integration-and-configuration.md 给出端点、鉴权头与权限，delivery-diagnostics.md 给出诊断证据顺序，Agent 可直接照用。

design.reason: 测试目标由"已注册定义∩已启用配置"推导，公开描述符不含配置/密钥，logs.js 对 message/recipient/lease 做脱敏。

reliability.reason: 阅读实现：store.js 在同一事务写入 attempt 与 delivery 的 status/lastError 并以 leaseToken 作条件，logs.js 稳定脱敏，摘要对 pending/unknown/failed 分支明确。

evidence.observation: registerProvider 要求 provider 有非空且去除首尾空白的全局唯一 type 和非空 messageType，重复注册会抛错；这是应用注册自定义 provider 时套用的扩展契约。
ProviderSendResult 是 accepted / failed(带 error、disposition、retryAfterMs) / submission_unknown 的闭联合，给自定义 provider 提供了表达成功、永久失败与结果不确定的类型化方式。
运行时把 accepted 落为 accepted，submission_unknown 落为 unknown，failed 且 disposition 为 same_provider 时按 maxAttempts 落为 retrying 或终态 failed，错误随 attempt 与 delivery 写入。
指引说明 NotificationProviderDefinition 需要全局唯一 type、messageType、可选 validateConfig 和 createProvider，并通过 notificationExtensionRegistryToken 的 registerChannel/registerProvider 组合注册。
evidence.excerpt:
A Provider implements `NotificationProviderDefinition` with globally unique `type`, `messageType`, optional `validateConfig`, and `createProvider(context, config)`. Configuration has a `provider` discriminator and flat transport options. The runtime exposes the same `type`, `send`, optional capabilities, and optional `close`. There is no Provider instance name.

```ts
const registry = app.container.resolve(notificationExtensionRegistryToken);
registry
  .registerChannel(createSmsChannelDefinition())
  .registerProvider(createExampleSmsProviderDefinition());
```

Provider definitions reference their reusable message handler through `messageType`. Extend `NotificationChannelSchemas` with the Provider identifier and its recipient/message schema so configured Channel names infer the correct `messages` values. Extension plugins register through `notificationExtensionRegistryToken` before activation; consumers send through `notificationServiceToken`.

evidence.observation: 结果分类要求：只有外部服务确认受理才返回 accepted；永久失败用 never、可重试失败用 same_provider；可能已到达但确认丢失用 submission_unknown；并列出标准错误类别。
evidence.excerpt:
## Result classification

Return `accepted` only when the external service confirms it accepted the submission. Include a Provider message id when available.

Return `failed` when the service definitively rejected or did not submit the message. Classify the error and choose retry disposition:

- `never` for invalid recipient/content/configuration and other permanent failures.
- `same_provider` for bounded transient failures such as a retryable rate limit or temporary network failure.
- Set `retryAfterMs` only from a validated Provider hint. The notification runtime uses the configured fixed retry interval when this field is absent.

Return `submission_unknown` when the request may have reached the Provider but confirmation was lost. This prevents automatic duplicates.

Declare Provider-side duplicate protection with `capabilities.idempotency`. This describes the external Provider contract only; it does not make an `unknown` Delivery directly retryable. Omitted capabilities are treated as `{ idempotency: { supported: false } }`. Set `{ supported: true }` only when repeated submissions with the same core-supplied `deliveryId` are idempotent; include `retentionMs` when the guarantee expires. The built-in database Provider is durable for the Delivery lifetime, Resend is bounded to its declared retention, and SMTP plus the built-in Webhook Providers omit capabilities because they do not claim idempotency.

Use the core error categories: `authentication`, `channel`, `configuration`, `content`, `network`, `provider`, `rate_limit`, `recipient`, `storage`, `timeout`, or `unknown`. Error messages must be actionable and sanitized.

evidence.observation: 导出 notificationServiceToken 与 notificationExtensionRegistryToken 两个服务 token，允许应用在不导入内部实现的情况下解析运行时与扩展注册表。
测试面包含 GET /targets、POST /send（202 返回结果）、GET /:id/status，并叠加 auth.required、notification:test/send 授权与 x-nocobase-notification-test 头校验。
listTestTargets 由注册表和配置推导；sendTest 解析目标、经 channel.test.toSendInput 构造消息后走正常 send()；getTestStatus 只返回 sourceType 为 notification-test 且属于当前用户的记录。
summarizeNotificationDeliveries 把全部 accepted 的投递汇总为 completed，含 unknown 为 unknown，全部 failed 为 failed，混合为 partial。

诊断证据顺序：从通知 id 到全部 delivery、再到 attempt/retry audit 与结构化日志；并说明受保护日志 API 故意省略消息与收件人快照。
evidence.excerpt:
## Evidence order

1. Resolve the exact Notification id from the send result, business source, or logs page.
2. Read the Notification summary and all Deliveries.
3. For each unexpected Delivery, record Channel, Provider identifier, status, attempt count, `nextRunAt`, and sanitized `lastError`.
4. Read Retry Audits and Attempts in order. A Retry Audit exists for every accepted manual retry request; an Attempt exists only after Provider submission starts. Identify whether failure happened before Provider submission, during a known failed submission, or after an uncertain submission.
5. Correlate structured server logs by Notification id, Delivery id, Attempt id, Channel, and Provider identity.
6. Inspect effective redacted configuration and runtime registration only after fixing the failing layer in the evidence chain.

The protected logs API intentionally omits message and recipient snapshots plus lease tokens. Use server-side business context for content diagnosis; do not weaken redaction or query raw tables merely to display secrets.

evidence.observation: 失败类别解释与"Provider 可请求同 provider 重试，达到次数上限后为终态 failed，运行时不会故障转移到另一 Provider"的说明。
evidence.excerpt:
### Failed

- `recipient`: the Channel rejects the recipient, the recipient is required but missing, or the address is invalid.
- `configuration`: definition, Provider identity, sender, or runtime configuration is missing/invalid.
- `authentication`: Provider credentials were rejected.
- `content`: rendered/prepared message violates Provider constraints.
- `network`, `rate_limit`, or `timeout`: inspect the Provider result, attempt count, and `nextRunAt`.
- `storage`: persistence or in-app inbox delivery failed.
- `provider` or `unknown`: inspect the Provider's sanitized response and correlated logs.

A Provider can request same-Provider retry. Once the configured attempt limit is exhausted, the Delivery becomes terminal failed. The runtime does not fail over to another Provider.

evidence.observation: 记录测试面三个端点、均需认证与 x-nocobase-notification-test 头、仅 send 需要 notification:test/send，并说明 targets 只含安全描述符、每次测试生成持久日志且仅创建者可见。
evidence.excerpt:
## Notification test surface

The core package exposes `GET /api/notifications/test/targets`, `POST /api/notifications/test/send`, and `GET /api/notifications/test/:id/status`. All three require authentication and `x-nocobase-notification-test: 1`; only `POST /send` requires the `notification:test` `send` permission. Logs remain separately protected by `page:notification.logs` `access`.

Targets are the intersection of registered definitions and enabled configured instances. Their public descriptors contain only Channel names, Provider identifiers, labels, and safe form-field metadata. Configuration, Webhook URLs, API keys, and secrets stay on the server. Channel definitions convert test fields into the same normal `send()` inputs; each test creates persistent logs, and status is visible only to its creating user.

A production test is a real external send and requires explicit scope, the recipient or recipientless mode, Channel, permission, and follow-up verification.

evidence.observation: AppConfigFactory 接收已解析的 runtime，defineAppConfig/defaultAppConfigs 是应用每个 server/config 段使用的工厂封装。
定义 AppApiRouteContribution（scope 'api'）与 defineApiRoutes/defineRootRoutes，路由贡献由应用 createRouter 返回自己的 Hono 实例。
startServiceProviders 顺序为 registerAll→registerLocales→bootAll→registerRoutes→startAll→readyAll，保证 boot() 时其它 provider 的 register() 已完成，可扩展插件拥有的注册表。
joinBasePath 把公共基路径与基路径内的路径规范化拼接，供应用在 /api 前正确加上部署挂载前缀。
ServiceProvider 声明 register/boot/start/ready/shutdown 生命周期与构造函数契约，应用 provider 据此接入。
明确"挂在 /api 不等于鉴权"，每个路由必须自持 auth，公开路由需要显式安全边界。
evidence.excerpt:
## Every route owns its own security

**Mounting under `/api` does not authenticate anything.** `/api` is a location. A route with no `auth.required()` is public regardless of where it mounts.

Never depend on middleware installed by another route, or on the order contributions happen to be registered in. Contribution order changes when a plugin is added, and a route protected only by someone else's middleware silently becomes public.

`auth.required()` rejects anonymous requests with `401`. `auth.optional()` attaches the session when present without rejecting.

evidence.observation: Provider 生命周期表：register 绑定 token、boot 处理需要其它服务的工作、start 启动长生命周期资源、shutdown 释放，并说明 server/config 使用 defineAppConfig。
evidence.excerpt:
## Provider lifecycle

| Method       | Runs                             | For                                              |
| ------------ | -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `register()` | Assembly, before anything starts | Binding tokens. Do not connect or start anything |
| `boot()`     | After all providers registered   | Work needing other services                      |
| `start()`    | Application start                | Long-lived resources: listeners, pollers         |
| `shutdown()` | Application stop                 | Releasing what `start()` acquired                |

Declaration modules must not connect to a database or start a worker at module top level.

evidence.observation: 能力表把 Email/IM/in-app 消息路由到 @nocobase/app-plugin-notification，并警告已有插件时手写通知发送器是最昂贵的错误。
evidence.excerpt:
| Email, IM, or in-app messages; notifying someone that something happened                          | `@nocobase/app-plugin-notification`   |
| Roles, permissions, "user A may only see their own records", field-level or row-level access      | `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization`  |
| Sign-in, registration, sessions, password reset                                                   | `@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication` |
| User listing, account state, password reset, and application-owned role assignment                | `@nocobase/app-plugin-users`          |
| File upload and metadata through Repository                                                       | `@nocobase/app-plugin-file`           |
| Translated text and language switching                                                            | `@nocobase/app-plugin-i18n`           |

Run `pnpm skills:sync` if `.agents/skills/` is missing or looks out of date, then read the Skill for the plugin you need. It documents that plugin's public entries, the ownership boundary, and how to verify the result — which is faster and more correct than inferring an API from its source.

Building a permission system, a notification sender, or a job scheduler by hand when a registered plugin already provides one is the most expensive mistake available here. Prefer the plugin; write your own only when you have read its Skill and confirmed it genuinely does not fit.

"title": "Cookie-authenticated POST to an application route is rejected with 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN when the app is started directly, not through pnpm dev",
      "symptom": "The new end-to-end test signed in successfully and could GET /api/notifications/test/targets, but POST /api/notifications/test/send always answered 403 {\"code\":\"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN\"} before reaching the route handler.",
      "rootCause": "Better Auth protects cookie-authenticated unsafe methods by checking the request Origin against its trustedOrigins. The application config leaves app.publicOrigin unset, so better-auth's baseURL is unset and its static trustedOrigins list is empty. pnpm dev compensates by injecting APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN and BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS into the server child, but a test or script that starts the runtime itself gets no trusted origin, so every cookie-authenticated write is rejected.",
      "resolution": "The end-to-end test now starts the runtime with APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN set to the loopback origin it listens on and sends a matching Origin header, mirroring what pnpm dev does for the browser. The product code was already correct; only the direct-call test setup was missing this environment.",

evidence.observation: SKILL.md 按概念、集成配置、发送、诊断、扩展的顺序路由阅读，并明确指出自定义传输通过 notificationExtensionRegistryToken 注册 provider、保留队列/租约/重试生命周期。
evidence.excerpt:
1. Read [Notification concepts](references/notification-concepts.md) for package ownership and delivery status semantics.
2. For plugin registration, configuration, migrations, or test APIs, read [Integration and configuration](references/integration-and-configuration.md). Configure a Channel name mapped to one flat Provider configuration.
3. For sending or typed consumers, read [Sending notifications](references/sending-notifications.md). Resolve `notificationServiceToken`; construct complete messages keyed by Channel name and use native recipient addresses. Validate the intended external effect before sending.
4. For failures and retries, read [Delivery diagnostics](references/delivery-diagnostics.md). Preserve Notification, Delivery, Attempt, and retry-audit history; distinguish accepted submission from final delivery.
5. For custom transports, read [Channel and Provider extensions](references/channel-and-provider-extensions.md). Register globally unique Provider definitions through `notificationExtensionRegistryToken` and retain the queue/lease/retry lifecycle.
6. Verify changed packages and consumers with lint, typecheck, tests, and build. Cover atomic validation, independent delivery, recipient rules, and retries bound to original identities.
